correctness.rationale: For any field k and n>=1, Lie homomorphism equations from H_{2n+1}=W+kz into sl2 are [psi(u),psi(v)]=omega(u,v)Z and [psi(u),Z]=0. In odd characteristic centralizers force Z=0 and commuting psi matrices have rank at most one, recovering the known D_{3,2n}^{<=1}. In characteristic two sl2 has basis h=I2,e,f with [e,f]=h central. Writing psi=a h+b e+c f yields b∧c=lambda omega. For n>=2 a decomposable 2-form rank<=2 cannot equal nonzero scalar multiple of symplectic rank2n>=4, so lambda=0 and rank(b,c)<=1. This gives reduced A^{2n}×D_{2,2n}^{<=1}, dim4n+1 and singular locus A^{2n}×{0}. For n=1 the z-image is uniquely [psi(x),psi(y)] and the full scheme is affine6. Counting rank-one matrices and the position of a relative to their row line yields all stated even-q rank profiles, with direct independent F2 H5 census (1,105,630) and original exhaustive tests over q2,3,4 corroborating. Nonreduced n>=2 Hom scheme is NOT classified; ranks are labelled map ranks.
